PREVIEW_BUSY.zh: 预览任务较多，请稍后重试
PREVIEW_BUSY.en: Too many previews are queued; try again shortly

PREVIEW_FAILED.zh: 无法解析此文件，可下载原文件查看
PREVIEW_FAILED.en: This file could not be parsed; download the original file to view it

PREVIEW_TIMEOUT.zh: 文件解析超时，可下载原文件查看
PREVIEW_TIMEOUT.en: The file took too long to parse; download the original file to view it

UNSUPPORTED_PREVIEW.en: Download this format to view it

PREVIEW_TOO_LARGE.zh: 文件超过 {limit} 预览上限，可下载原文件查看
PREVIEW_TOO_LARGE.en: The file exceeds the {limit} preview limit; download the original instead

VISUALIZATION_TOO_LARGE.zh: 交互预览超过 {limit}，请打开源码查看
VISUALIZATION_TOO_LARGE.en: The preview exceeds {limit}; open the source instead

INVALID_VISUALIZATION.zh: {subject, select, file {交互预览必须是 HTML 文件} text {交互预览必须是 HTML 文本} other {交互预览必须是 HTML}}
INVALID_VISUALIZATION.en: {subject, select, file {A visualization preview must be an HTML file} text {A visualization preview must be an HTML text} other {A visualization preview must be HTML}}
